intro.fr: Huniecam Studio se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: Huniecam Studio can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub DotsofdarknessArchipelago/Hunie-Cam-Studio-Archipelago, qui héberge l'APWorld de Huniecam Studio.
text.en: The GitHub repository DotsofdarknessArchipelago/Hunie-Cam-Studio-Archipelago, home of the Huniecam Studio APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, V0.1.0.
text.en: The first version, V0.1.0, is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version 0.4.0, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (7 versions publiées).
text.en: Version 0.4.0 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (7 versions released).

text.fr: Huniecam Studio figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: Huniecam Studio is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
